body:
I'm on the middle of developing this feature. It's quite huge as it increase the complexity of the search state because of the need to introduce an "indices" namespace. 

I also encounter some edge cases and want to give you a little update on the api I'm implementing. 

```js
 <InstantSearch
    appId=""
    apiKey=""
    indexName="first">
    <CurrentRefinements /> // widgets that are here are parameters that will be shared among every indices. 
    <MultiIndexContext indexName="first">
      <RefinementList attributeName="category" /> // widgets that are here only target first
      <CustomHits />
      <Configure hitsPerPage={1} />
      <SortBy/>
    </MultiIndexContext>
    <MultiIndexContext indexName="second"> 
      <Configure hitsPerPage={1}/> //widgets that are here only target second
      <RefinementList attributeName="categories" />
      <CustomHits />
      <SortBy/>
    </MultiIndexContext>
<InstantSearch/>
```

Let me know what you think about it.
